author: HBO Max
description:
On Season 2, Episode 3 of DC Studios Showcase: The Official Podcast, hosts Frankey and Coy sit down with Supergirl director Craig Gillespie for an inside look at one of the DCU’s most anticipated films yet. From practical alien effects and massive Lobo stunts to Milly Alcock’s version of Supergirl/Kara Zor-El and how her introduction connects directly to Superman, this episode is packed with exclusive access DC fans can’t miss!

Frankey and Coy talk with Craig Gillespie about bringing Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow to life inside the new DC Universe, balancing dark comedy with emotional storytelling, and why this version of Kara is unlike any superhero audiences have seen before. Plus: next-level practical effects, Jason Momoa’s Lobo entrance, Krypto, behind-the-scenes filmmaking secrets, and the ongoing debate over whether Supergirl “has that dog in her.”

✅ Craig Gillespie reveals why Milly Alcock was the perfect Kara for the DCU
